description: Ledger of the real evidence behind this package. Citations point at files of the SOURCE PROJECT (the clone and its specs) that sit next to this folder during a build and are not part of the delivered package. extraction/verify_all.py checks every citation when a sibling source tree exists and degrades to a warning when it does not.

copyBudgets.method: maxWords = ceil(maxChars / 5.5). maxChars is the largest character count the clone placeholder tables record for that role; quote is the literal found at the cited line.

spacingHistogram.method: count of gap/padding/margin utilities with a literal pixel value in src/**/*.jsx at build time; the spacing scale keeps values used 28 or more times

sectionHeights.measuredWith: extraction/measure_sections.mjs (headless Chromium via Playwright, viewport 1440x900, page scrolled through once before reading)
sectionHeights.reproduction: The shipped extraction/measure_sections.mjs was run a second time against the finished package (templates.json sample routes, 59 templates): every band height and document height was identical to the recorded values.

product-feature.note: Sample route /product/dives; the other members use the same spine with different optional blocks (see templates.json routeEvidence).

legal-toc.note: Band 1 holds the table of contents and every clause section in one DOM container.

gated-lp.note: Sample route /lp/ai-analytics-eval-field-guide-full: one stat/benchmark band, one prose band and three card bands.

webinar-detail.note: Sample route renders the standard layout; the register-LP and side-form layouts were not re-measured here.

wrapperGate.thresholds: pinned in extraction/wrapper_gate.py: HERO warn 1800 / error 3000; section share warn 50% / error 60%; pages with fewer than 3 in-flow bands skipped

whitelist.justification: The case study index exists to list its 20 cards (PAGES_SPEC_CONTENT section 9 item counts); the other bands are a 327px title band, a 598px testimonial carousel and a 253px heading row, so the share is structural and hides no other section.
whitelist.reviewedBy: build agent - agent attestation, not a human sign-off

whitelist.justification: The gallery page is nav, a 345px hero, a 191px filter band, the card grid (first 9 cards, load-more) and a 455px footer; the grid is the page purpose and each card is a component, not a section.
whitelist.reviewedBy: build agent - agent attestation, not a human sign-off

liveVsCloneHeights.kind: section-height comparison only; NOT a pixel-parity measurement
liveVsCloneHeights.tool: extraction/compare_live_bands.mjs (run against the live site and the running clone at 1440px on 2026-10-26)

rows.bandDeltaNote: band counts differ (live 8, clone 9); only document height is compared
band counts differ (live 2, clone 3); only document height is compared

liveVsCloneHeights.summary: about-us, careers, contact-us/product-expert and privacy-policy match the live document height exactly; the homepage matches every band within 1px and is 14px taller overall (footer 1021.1 vs 1006.7 in this run); /vs/snowflake-alternative is 29px taller (the compare-cards band, +28.8px); /product/pricing is 202px shorter (plan matrix, instances + logos and value rows are shorter); /blog is 12px taller.

cloneRunnability.steps: copy of the project without node_modules, dist and this package into an empty directory; npm ci; npm run build (vite build)
cloneRunnability.result: installed 133 packages and built successfully (vite reported built in 2.23s); the dev server on port 5190 served every sample route used for the section-height measurements with HTTP 200
cloneRunnability.note: Only the build and the served routes were verified; no browser-driven interaction test was run.

buildNotes: Other files (ia.json, IA.md, matrix.csv, build.mjs, validate.mjs, README.md) appeared in the project root while this package was being built, from a separate process. They were not used as evidence and not modified.
No file under src/ was modified after 07:40 on 2026-10-26 (re-checked at the end of the build), which is before this package was started, so line citations were taken against a stable tree.

pixelParity.statement: The project has no live-versus-clone pixel-parity harness. QA rounds measured section heights and tokens against the live site; those numbers are in the PAGES_SPEC_* files and in liveVsCloneHeights above. No parity percentage is claimed.

knownGaps.description: A real sitemap URL that matches /lp/:slug but currently renders the not-found style stub (PageStub) because the gated LP dataset in src/pages/company/Gated.jsx has no entry for that slug. Recorded, not fixed.
Each spec lists what it did not measure (CLONE_SPEC section 12; PAGES_SPEC_EXTRA section 2). The affected contracts carry evidence.level partially-measured with the note.
See liveVsCloneHeights: homepage +14px, pricing -202px, comparison page +29px, blog +12px against the live site.
The homepage A/B video hero variant is documented in CLONE_SPEC section 3 but not built; the control (tabbed simulation) variant is the target.
The dither strip algorithm and frame rate are UNMEASURED (CLONE_SPEC section 12).

cloneObservations: Dive gallery chrome and the ecosystem call-to-action show the stand-in brand text Northwind (src/components/content/diveChrome.jsx, eco.jsx, DiveGallery.jsx); the source-brand registry blocks it for generated pages.

public/assets/photos holds 91 free-licensed photographs of real strangers (CC BY, CC BY-SA, CC0, Unsplash) used as portrait and team stand-ins; several are labelled customer-n or author-n. Attribution is required for the CC BY and CC BY-SA files (CREDITS.md). Not reusable for generated pages.
PAGES_SPEC_EXTRA section 13 recommends excluding /try like /docs; the clone instead renders a static non-functional shell (Try.jsx) and keeps EXCLUDED_PREFIXES to /docs only.
The label WHY MOTHERDUCK in the specs is rendered WHY CHOOSE US? in the clone (neutral placeholder copy, by design).

/product/guides and /glossary are served by the clone but are not in the sitemap snapshot (the glossary index is documented as existing on the original); /lp/ducklake-lakehouse-table-format-book is a redirect target, not a sitemap URL.

routeResolution.method: most specific matching pattern; static patterns win over parameter patterns (react-router ranking)
